type.title: Package Type
enumDescriptions: Main packages, with the exception of your own package interfaces and subpackages, cannot contain other repository objects. Subpackages, in turn, can be other main packages and the standard development packages.

applicationComponent.title: Application Component
applicationComponent.description: Name used to identify the application component

softwareComponent.title: Software Component
softwareComponent.description: The software component describes a set of objects that are always delivered together.

transportLayer.title: Transport Layer
transportLayer.description: The transport layer determines whether objects are assigned to a local or transportable change request.

supportsRecordChanges.title: Record Object Changes in Transport Requests
supportsRecordChanges.description: This flag indicates whether the Transport Organizer records changes made to objects in this package. If changes are recorded, version management is also activated for the objects in this package.

isAddingObjectsNotAllowed.title: Adding Further Objects not Allowed
isAddingObjectsNotAllowed.description: If you set this flag, users cannot create new objects within the package. However, they can move existing objects to other packages.

isEncapsulated.title: Encapsulated
isEncapsulated.description: When this package property is activated, the package is encapsulated. The consequence of this is that only the development elements exposed in package interfaces of the package are visible to the outside. Possible client packages need use access to those package interfaces that contain the development objects used. Otherwise, errors occur during the package check.

defaultAbapLanguageVersion.title: Default ABAP Language Version
defaultAbapLanguageVersion.description: Determines ABAP Language Version for all new objects within the package.

useAccesses.title: Use Accesses
useAccesses.description: The use access gives a package the right to use the development elements in the package interface of another package. Note that this right is one-way only.
